caveats: Low reach is not the same as unmet need. Another organisation may already serve a place where you reach few people.
Need is a count of people, so a large local authority is more likely to be listed as high need than a small one with the same rate.
Reach sets the people you helped against everyone counted as in need. The people you helped may not all be in that group.
The need figures describe census day, 21 March 2021. Unemployment was affected by the pandemic then and has changed since. Full-time students who were looking for work are not counted.
warnings: 10 people live outside the catchment and are left out. Change the 'catchment' option to include them.
The area compared was worked out from where your people live, so it holds only places you already reach. To see places you do not reach, name the area you could serve with the 'catchment' option.
Only 4 local authorities are compared, so 'high need' says little. It means the top quarter, and at least one place.
